title: Chemical Equipment Operators and Tenders
description: Operate or tend equipment to control chemical changes or reactions in the processing of industrial or consumer products. Equipment used includes devulcanizers, steam-jacketed kettles, and reactor vessels.

tasks.text: Observe safety precautions to prevent fires or explosions.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical presence maintaining safety in world

dwas.name: Maintain safety.

tasks.text: Patrol work areas to detect leaks or equipment malfunctions or to monitor operating conditions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Malfunction detection relies on live physical observation

dwas.name: Watch operating equipment to detect malfunctions.

tasks.text: Monitor gauges, recording instruments, flowmeters, or products to ensure that specified conditions are maintained.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Instrument monitoring needs physical sensor presence

dwas.name: Monitor instruments to ensure proper production conditions.

tasks.text: Inspect equipment or units to detect leaks or malfunctions, shutting equipment down, if necessary.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical inspection of production machinery in situ

dwas.name: Inspect production equipment.
Operate chemical processing or water treatment systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Record operational data, such as temperatures, pressures, ingredients used, processing times, or test results.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Draw samples of products at specified stages so that analyses can be performed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual product sampling

dwas.name: Collect samples of materials or products for testing.

tasks.text: Measure, weigh, and mix chemical ingredients, according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measuring and dispensing of ingredients

dwas.name: Measure ingredients or substances to be used in production processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Mix substances to create chemical solutions.

tasks.text: Open valves or start pumps, agitators, reactors, blowers, or automatic feed of materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Pumping systems operated and adjusted in field

dwas.name: Operate pumping systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Test product samples for specific gravity, chemical characteristics, pH levels, concentrations, or viscosities, or send them to laboratories for testing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical/physical testing requires lab manipulation

dwas.name: Test chemical or physical characteristics of materials or products.

tasks.text: Adjust controls to regulate temperature, pressure, feed, or flow of liquids or gases and times of prescribed reactions, according to knowledge of equipment and processes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate gas flow.
Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Control or operate equipment in which chemical changes or reactions take place during the processing of industrial or consumer products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical and water systems controlled physically on site

dwas.name: Operate chemical processing or water treatment systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Load products into tanks for shipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lifting and loading of shipments

dwas.name: Load shipments, belongings, or materials.
Load materials into equipment for processing.
Load materials or equipment.

tasks.text: Estimate materials required for production and manufacturing of products.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Material requirement calc; human confirms specs

dwas.name: Estimate material requirements for production.

tasks.text: Dump or scoop prescribed solid, granular, or powdered materials into equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on loading of materials into equipment

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.

tasks.text: Read plant specifications to determine products, ingredients, or prescribed modifications of plant procedures.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Notify maintenance engineers of equipment malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Notifying maintenance needs is routine messaging

dwas.name: Notify others of equipment repair or maintenance needs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Drain equipment, and pump water or other solutions through to flush and clean tanks or equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of equipment in unstructured settings

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.

tasks.text: Observe and compare colors and consistencies of products to instrument readings and to laboratory and standard test results.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Vision AI assists but physical comparison is human

dwas.name: Compare physical characteristics of materials or products to specifications or standards.

tasks.text: Add treating or neutralizing agents to products, and pump products through filters or centrifuges to remove impurities or to precipitate products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of equipment in unstructured settings

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.

tasks.text: Implement appropriate industrial emergency response procedures.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing production operations is human supervisory authority

dwas.name: Direct operational or production activities.

tasks.text: Make minor repairs, lubricate, and maintain equipment, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on repair of production machinery

dwas.name: Repair production equipment or tools.
Maintain production or processing equipment.
Lubricate production equipment.

tasks.text: Flush or clean equipment, using steam hoses or mechanical reamers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of equipment in unstructured settings

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.

tasks.text: Direct activities of workers assisting in control or verification of processes or in unloading of materials.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing production operations is human supervisory authority

dwas.name: Direct operational or production activities.

tasks.text: Inventory supplies received and consumed.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.
